title: ECP Protocol Identity
description: Versioned identity of the Evidentiary Evaluation Protocol. A single normative identity document (ECP-IDENTITY.json at the repository root) pins protocol_name, protocol_version, schema_version and repository_version. Every evaluation artifact MUST cite the protocol version (and, where defined, the schema version) it was produced under; no implicit 'current version' semantics exist.

protocol_status.description: Maturity of the protocol semantics. R0 ships as 'draft'.

schema_version.description: Version of the schema bundle in schemas/.

repository_version.description: Version of the repository content release. Distinct from protocol semantics and from the git commit id.

canonicalization.description: The canonical serialization scheme used for all commitments and hashes.

hash_algorithm.description: The hash algorithm used for all artifacts, manifests and commitments.
